headline: 19 senior police officers transferred after Rangpur killings
summary: The government reshuffled key posts in RPMP, Rab, DMP and other units following the death of four family members in Rangpur.
details: The government has transferred 19 senior police officers across several units, including the appointment of a new Rangpur Metropolitan Police (RPMP) commissioner.
This major reshuffle follows the killing of four family members in Rangpur, affecting key positions in the RPMP, Rab, and Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP).
Special Branch DIG Mahbubur Rashid has been appointed as the new RPMP commissioner, while PBI DIG Md Humayun Kabir has been moved to Rab as additional director general.
Other significant changes include the appointment of DMP joint commissioner Tofayel Ahmed Mia and the transfer of several SPs from PBI to CID and APBn.
The home ministry issued three notifications signed by Deputy Secretary Tousif Ahmed to formalize these transfers.
The reshuffle also includes the cancellation of previous orders from December 2023 and May 2024 for certain officers, redirecting them to Police Headquarters or other districts.
caption:
19 senior police officers reshuffled. This follows the killing of four family members in Rangpur.

The government has transferred 19 senior police officers across several units, including the appointment of a new Rangpur Metropolitan Police (RPMP) commissioner.

This major reshuffle follows the killing of four family members in Rangpur, affecting key positions in the RPMP, Rab, and Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP).

Special Branch DIG Mahbubur Rashid has been appointed as the new RPMP commissioner, while PBI DIG Md Humayun Kabir has been moved to Rab as additional director general.

Other significant changes include the appointment of DMP joint commissioner Tofayel Ahmed Mia and the transfer of several SPs from PBI to CID and APBn.

The home ministry issued three notifications signed by Deputy Secretary Tousif Ahmed to formalize these transfers.

The reshuffle also includes the cancellation of previous orders from December 2023 and May 2024 for certain officers, redirecting them to Police Headquarters or other districts.

headline: Two reserved female UP members arrested with yaba in Rajbari
summary: Police recovered 30 pieces of yaba from the women, who represent different wards of the Majbari Union Parishad.
details: The District Detective (DB) police of Rajbari arrested two reserved female Union Parishad (UP) members on Tuesday afternoon in Pangsha.

The police team, led by SI Shimul Sheikh, conducted an operation in the Pangsha Model Police Station area and recovered 30 pieces of yaba from the road in front of 'Wood Word Furniture' shop on College Road.
The arrested women have been identified as Hamida Khatun (47) and Sajeda Begum (40), both from the Majbari Union Parishad in Kalukhali Upazila.
Hamida Khatun represents wards 1, 2, and 3, while Sajeda Begum represents wards 7, 8, and 9 of the same union.
Rajbari DB Police OC Mo. Mofizul Islam confirmed the arrest and stated that legal action has been taken against them.
Majbari Union Parishad Chairman Kazi Shariful Islam mentioned he had heard about the arrests but has not yet been officially notified by the administration.
